verdict.rationale: Workable ships its own AI features, including the Workable Agent, so letting users connect external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The pack only documents Workable's own MCP server, which exposes Workable to other agents. That is the server role and does not show that Workable can consume external MCP servers' tools. There is no evidence of MCP-client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
